subject: Re: RP10 schema issues resolved — W2.d RP11 plan confirmed
body:
GR — confirmed. W2.d at 4 slots is not blocking RP10. Adding the 5th in RP11 is the right call.

RP10 looks clean from a data perspective. Schema fix just committed: added version, fr_approved, fr_approved_date, fr_approval_notes to schema as optional fields so FR's approval workflow validates cleanly. CI gate is now green: 10/10 exams, 0 errors.

One note for RP11 design: when you add the W2.d question, run node scripts/concept-coverage.cjs after to confirm the count moves to 5. Also check node scripts/resolve-duplicate-signatures.cjs — W2.d answer space is unconstrained (no duplicates there yet).

Good work on the RP10 turnaround.
